Refitting

- Position the vehicle on the lift.

1. Release the pipe from the solenoid valve.

- Raise the vehicle.

1. Remove the rivets using a drill fitted with a suitable size helical point.
1. Disconnect the rapid connector (1a) from the active charcoal filter, release the pipe (1b) from the fastenings and remove it.

Refitting

Removing

- Fit the pipe, connect the rapid connector to the active charcoal filter and renew the pipe fastenings.

- Refit the rivets fixing the heat shield removed previously using a riveter.

- Lower the vehicle.

- Fit the pipe on the solenoid valve.

- Remove the vehicle from the lift.
